description:
Cast Temporal Manipulation by paying its mana cost.
Kykar triggers, exiling Pinnacle Monk // Mystic Peak.
Resolve Temporal Manipulation, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
At the beginning of your end step, Kykar triggers, returning Pinnacle Monk // Mystic Peak from exile to the battlefield.
When Pinnacle Monk // Mystic Peak enters, it triggers, returning Temporal Manipulation from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat each turn.
